audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the level chart disagreed with both the packet chart and the already-audited mirror. The page read Gangplank / Skill / Riven / Riven / Gangplank / Riven / Riven.
audit.why: The packet chart and the gangplank__riven audit agree exactly: Riven / Riven / Skill / Skill / Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank. The page had the shape inverted — it gave Gangplank the early lane and Riven the two-item lane, which is backwards for a 53.12% Riven matchup against a scaling crit champion.
audit.corrected: All seven rows flipped as matched full+content pairs, with ratings set to the inverse of the mirror's: 7/10, 7/10, 5/10, 5/10, 5/10, 3/10, 2/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item and two-item rows were credited to Riven while the prose in the same file says Sheen-stacked keg chains outscale her.
audit.why: spikes[3], whys[5], whys[6] and 'late' all describe Gangplank taking over once Trinity Force lands. The chart contradicted the page's own scaling story.
audit.corrected: First item and 2+ items now read Gangplank, matching the mirror; spikes[3] rewritten around the real item names plus the anti-heal timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cannon Barrage's true damage was never stated, and Remove Scurvy's cooldown was given only as 'long' / 'roughly 20 seconds'.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage is flagged trueDamage — armour and MR do nothing inside it, so the page's Plated Steelcaps line reads as if resistances answer his ult. Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14, and it cleanses your Ki Burst stun, so its exact cooldown is the gate on every all-in.
audit.corrected: whys[4] now names Cannon Barrage and its true damage; whys[1] gives Remove Scurvy's real 22-second rank-1 cooldown as the all-in timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page told the player to buy Grievous Wounds, despite Remove Scurvy being real sustain through a long trade.
audit.why: The missingInteractions entry flags needs-antiheal for Remove Scurvy. Unlike the reverse page, this one is legitimate — Gangplank actually heals.
audit.corrected: Executioner's named in spikes[3] tied to Remove Scurvy rather than as a generic template line.

audit.why: The Riot name is Powder Keg, singular; the packet flagged it and it is a genuine hit, not a false positive.

edits.before: Gangplank has a ranged basic attack and can plant Powder Kegs at Level 1 before you have your W stun — deny his barrels with autos and do not step through barrel clusters trying to CS.
edits.after: Parrrley costs 50 mana at rank 1 and a Powder Keg has to arm before it is dangerous — walk him down with Q-auto weaves while he has one keg and no Remove Scurvy yet.

edits.before: W comes online and he has no reliable escape; the moment a barrel explodes on cooldown, E in and W-stun him before he replants — he cannot cleanse yet if Remove Scurvy is still on long cooldown.
edits.after: Ki Burst comes online and he has no escape; the moment a keg pops, E in and stun him before he replants — Remove Scurvy is a 22-second cooldown at rank 1, so time your all-in to it.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile gives you execute threat via Wind Slash, but his global R lets him detonate barrels in your all-in path or peel from anywhere — force the all-in only with a solid HP lead.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile arms Wind Slash, but Cannon Barrage is global and deals true damage — armour will not save you inside it, so force the all-in with an HP lead and off the zone.

edits.before: Trinity Force into Infinity Edge or Sheen-stacked barrels start one-shotting you from range; he no longer needs to lane against you to win fights.
edits.after: Trinity Force into Infinity Edge makes keg chains one-shot you from range; buy Executioner's if Remove Scurvy heals him out of your combo, and end early.

edits.before: Explode his Powder Kegs before he chains them so he loses the poke pattern and the gold
edits.after: Explode each Powder Keg before he chains them so he loses the poke pattern and the gold

notes: The packet's second suspectName ('Use Remove Scurvy') is a FALSE POSITIVE — Remove Scurvy is the correct Riot name for Gangplank's W. The first ('Powder Kegs') is a real hit and is fixed.
